result.definition: High-influence reflections describe using a high bar for moderation that generally keeps opinions but removes posts when they become threatening, excessively vulgar, slanderous, or otherwise toxic/inflammatory.
result.salience_notes: The sampled features cohere around specific removal triggers (personal threats, profanity/vulgarity, slander/obscenity) and a civil/toxic threshold, with an overall bias toward minimal moderation unless harm signals appear.
